results.text: The TripAgent Attractions database service is available.
Each attraction can have customer reviews with a rating from 1 to 5. The average_rating field is recalculated automatically whenever a new review is submitted.
The categories of attractions available are Sightseeing, Culture, Adventure, Entertainment and Food & Drink.

The Attractions Service provides AI-assisted recommendations using a Plan-Act-Observe-Adapt pattern: it extracts city, category, budget and preferences from a free-text request, filters real database candidates, and only then asks the LLM to explain the best matches.
